validationRepairs: Volume private holds reuse the actual device/storage harness and retain all2D/cube observations. Fake levels include cached volume pointers, and base-texture AddRef dispatches through the actual resource family.64 replacement cycles cover2D->cube->volume->2D with all public refs dropped before replacement. Existing private-data mutation selectors follow moved volume storage teardown.

Reset no longer has a public sampler-reference scan after all three texture families moved to private bindings. The retained D3D9 last-sampler mutation was replaced by a private-sampler-public-discount mutation, preserving strict compile/runtime detection; D3D8 retains its original last-slot control.

The first volume wire reader expected explicit MIN/MAG POINT writes. These are the shared default and the guest suppresses redundant writes; reader now initializes those defaults while independently requiring the explicit mip-filter/selected-mip transitions. A leftover cube target variable was removed. Production, SDK and XP capture were unchanged.

Volume uploads use UpdateTexture.z,depth1 and a tightly packed slice_pitch, distinct from cube resource kind/target-face addressing. Reader validates seven exact slice uploads, including one partial slice edit, and45 deliberate corruptions. XP pixels are transport acknowledgments; independent real GPU pixels validate both mip levels, edited/retained slices and post-Reset contents. Original Microsoft HAL and remaining resource families are not claimed.
